title: Oxidation beyond the aldehyde
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: A strong aqueous oxidant converts a primary alcohol to a carboxylic acid. The same terminal carbon ends up bonded to both the carbonyl oxygen and OH.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanol under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanol is treated with aqueous chromic acid. Which major organic product forms after workup? A strong aqueous oxidant converts a primary alcohol to a carboxylic acid. The same terminal carbon ends up bonded to both the carbonyl oxygen and OH.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
